issue: Purchased first free-spin origin is not anchored after history becomes nonempty
severity: defence-in-depth validation gap, not a demonstrated client payout exploit
clientReachability: HTTP operations contain action, stake/settings at start or sessionId/revision at move; clients do not send the full saved view. The forged object is injected directly into the local validator, bypassing the trusted server store. This does not show that a player can change a multiplier.
rootCause: validLuelonLineHistory anchors purchased initial features only when history is empty. With nonempty purchased history, the first featuresBefore multiplier is not compared with mode.startMultiplier; all subsequent arithmetic can be internally consistent.
qualificationConstraint: The affected mathematical validation source is frozen by the RTP gate. A fix requires a reviewed Cosmic policy and full-round qualification with source hashes; the legacy baseline must not be changed to bypass it.
